blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.21
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.21

blocks.text: शुद्धविद्योदयाच्चक्रेशत्वसिद्धिः
blocks.directed: [slowly] शुद्धविद्योदयाच्चक्रेशत्वसिद्धिः

blocks.text: Śuddhavidyodayāc cakreśatvasiddhiḥ.
blocks.directed: Śuddhavidyodayāc cakreśatvasiddhiḥ.

blocks.text: Through the arising of pure knowledge, mastery over the circle of powers is attained.
blocks.directed: Through the arising of pure knowledge, mastery over the circle of powers is attained.

blocks.text: You’ve Been Promoted to Manager of the Entire Śakti Department.
blocks.directed: You’ve Been Promoted to Manager of the Entire Śakti Department.

blocks.text: Now Vasugupta connects spiritual sovereignty to śuddhavidyā.
blocks.directed: Now Vasugupta connects spiritual sovereignty to śuddhavidyā.

blocks.text: Pure knowledge.
blocks.directed: Pure knowledge.

blocks.text: Importantly, this is not simply a person becoming exceptionally well educated.
blocks.directed: Importantly, this is not simply a person becoming exceptionally well educated.

blocks.text: Nor is it a collection of correct philosophical opinions.
blocks.directed: Nor is it a collection of correct philosophical opinions.

blocks.text: Śuddhavidyā is also a technical category within the Trika system of the thirty-six tattvas.
blocks.directed: Śuddhavidyā is also a technical category within the Trika system of the thirty-six tattvas.

blocks.text: The five pure tattvas are:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The five pure tattvas are:

blocks.text:
Śiva
Śakti
Sadāśiva
Īśvara
Śuddhavidyā
They describe pure modalities of consciousness and its manifestation before the limitations associated with Māyā and the contracted individual.
blocks.directed:
Śiva
Śakti
Sadāśiva
Īśvara
Śuddhavidyā
They describe pure modalities of consciousness and its manifestation before the limitations associated with Māyā and the contracted individual.

blocks.text: Within this pure domain, the relation between aham — I — and idam — this — is not experienced through the same fundamental alienation that characterises ordinary differentiated existence.
blocks.directed: Within this pure domain, the relation between aham — I — and idam — this — is not experienced through the same fundamental alienation that characterises ordinary differentiated existence.

blocks.text: And that’s the essential point.
blocks.directed: And that’s the essential point.

blocks.text: At the beginning, the individual was bound by limited knowing.
blocks.directed: At the beginning, the individual was bound by limited knowing.

blocks.text: Now pure knowledge has arisen.
blocks.directed: Now pure knowledge has arisen.

blocks.text: The yogi recognises the fundamental relation between the conscious subject and its powers of manifestation.
blocks.directed: The yogi recognises the fundamental relation between the conscious subject and its powers of manifestation.

blocks.text: And this leads to cakreśatva.
blocks.directed: And this leads to cakreśatva.

blocks.text: Lordship over the circle of powers.
blocks.directed: Lordship over the circle of powers.

blocks.text: Remember our previous encounter with śakticakra?
blocks.directed: Remember our previous encounter with śakticakra?

blocks.text: The wheel or collective of powers.
blocks.directed: The wheel or collective of powers.

blocks.text: At 1.6, their union was associated with the withdrawal of the universe.
blocks.directed: At 1.6, their union was associated with the withdrawal of the universe.

blocks.text: Here, the rise of pure knowledge is associated with mastery over them.
blocks.directed: Here, the rise of pure knowledge is associated with mastery over them.

blocks.text: The progression is deliberate.
blocks.directed: The progression is deliberate.

blocks.text: The powers that once seemed to scatter your consciousness into countless apparently separate objects are no longer experienced as fundamentally alien to their source.
blocks.directed: The powers that once seemed to scatter your consciousness into countless apparently separate objects are no longer experienced as fundamentally alien to their source.

blocks.text: The master of the powers is not an independent ego controlling an external collection of cosmic instruments.
blocks.directed: The master of the powers is not an independent ego controlling an external collection of cosmic instruments.

blocks.text: The sovereign reality is Śiva himself.
blocks.directed: The sovereign reality is Śiva himself.

blocks.text: And the realised yogi recognises their identity with that reality.
blocks.directed: And the realised yogi recognises their identity with that reality.
